Aug 25, 2026: NeurIPS has no affiliation or partnership with any third-party service that claims to collect registration or housing information on our behalf.  The only authorized source for NeurIPS registration and Housing is through the official NeurIPS website. Please do not share registration details with any outside party.

July 23, 2026: Due to a technical issue during release, we are currently re-releasing all reviews and initial meta-reviews. Reviews will be temporarily offline during that time.
